title: mFARM: Towards Multi-Faceted Fairness Assessment based on HARMs in Clinical Decision Support

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic substitution of racial identifiers (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) in clinical decision-support prompts, measuring variations in model output using the mFARM framework (Allocational, Stability, and Latent harms) while keeping clinical facts constant.

Counterfactual demographic substitution of gender identifiers (Male, Female, Intersex) in clinical decision-support prompts, measuring variations in model output using the mFARM framework (Allocational, Stability, and Latent harms) while keeping clinical facts constant.
